fetched_title: SCOPE: Selective Conformal Optimized Pairwise LLM Judging
summary: Calibrates an abstention threshold so error among non-abstained pairwise judgments is at most alpha, using a bidirectional preference entropy score. Pairwise judging with abstention; no target-absent candidate pools, no listwise-vs-pointwise comparison, no same-model rank-then-verify.
